Pattern: full ErrorBoundary.description:
Handles all three cases: a thrown `Response` (with a 404 branch), a real `Error`, and anything else.
Stack traces stay behind a DEV check so they never reach production output.

Pattern: 404 from a loader.description:
Throw a 404 when the record is missing, instead of returning `null` and null-checking in the component.
The nearest `ErrorBoundary` renders, and the status is correct for crawlers and monitoring.

Pattern: catch-all 404 route.description: Framework mode catch-all. Put it last in `routes.ts`.

Pattern: error boundary in Data mode rou.description: Data mode error handling. An error bubbles to the nearest route that defines one, so a root-level boundary is the safety net.
